meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 装上后，你给出一个 GitHub 拉取请求（链接、owner/repo#N 或当前仓库里的“这个 PR”），Claude 会把它的代码差异、提交和文件整理成一支代码变更讲解视频，涵盖变更日志、新功能、修复或重构。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 GitHub 拉取请求的引用（完整 URL、owner/repo#N 或当前仓库中的“这个 PR”）并要求把它做成视频时触发。其他不明意图的视频请求会先转给 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 为 owner/repo#42 做一支代码变更视频
say.note: 无需完整链接，给出仓库和编号即可。

say.text: 我当前仓库里有这个 PR，给它做个视频
say.note: 在已检出仓库中直接指代当前 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, if you give a GitHub pull request (a URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo), Claude turns its diff, commits, and files into an explainer video covering changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want a GitHub pull request turned into a video and provide a PR reference (full URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo). Other unclear video requests go through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a video: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123
say_en.note: Claude fetches the PR and starts planning the video.

say_en.text: Make a code-change video for owner/repo#42
say_en.note: No full link needed; just owner/repo and number.

say_en.text: Make a video for this PR in my current repo
